Italian Driver Leads F1 Championship Ahead of Monza

Andrea Kimi Antonelli is set to enter the Monza Grand Prix as the first Italian driver to lead the Formula 1 championship before his home race since 1953. Antonelli has secured six wins and six pole positions in the current 2026 season. Despite a grid penalty, former driver Giancarlo Fisichella has expressed support for Antonelli's potential to compete strongly at Monza.
